name: Inguva SatyaVenkata Sai Kumar
bio: I am a Software Engineer with 2+ years of experience building AI-integrated web applications using Python, FastAPI, React.js, and Vue.js at NStarX. I architected GenAI Lab, a Micro Frontend platform, where multiple AI services including RAG, Multimodal, and Report Generator run independently with role-based access control and ArgoCD deployment. I also built real-time pod and cluster monitoring dashboards in Vue.js for the Digital Human project, shipped 20+ FastAPI REST APIs with response times under 200ms, and worked with AWS services across projects. Outside of work, I independently built FilmSense, an AI movie assistant using a hybrid RAG pipeline and Qdrant vector database, which reflects my passion for building GenAI systems beyond my day job. I am currently looking for Full Stack Python Developer roles where I can keep building real, scalable, production-grade systems.
